messages:
Jordan (partnerships): quick sync — want to align a reseller SKU repack + renewal surge play across marketplace private offers and HW partner credits before the joint announcement next month. short thread to capture owners and risks.
Sam (marketplace-sales): yes — thinking two SKU tracks: 1) consumption/commit SKU (12/24mo tiers) and 2) appliance-bundle SKU (reserved + HW credit). enable private-offer templates per tier.
Lina (legal): high level ok. need to validate private-offer discounting vs marketplace/reseller rules (some marketplaces require minimum list on public offers). also will need specific clause for HW credit fulfillment timeline.
Deepak (hw-partner): from HW side we can do a rebate credit (USD 50k ladder) tied to device activation within 90 days. need activation webhook/event.
Elise (field-ops): timeline constraint — product announcement week of Apr 14. sales enablement, demo images, and partner-facing FAQ must be ready by Apr 7.
Sam (marketplace-sales): action proposal: I’ll produce a SKU mapping spreadsheet (public SKU -> private-offer SKU -> resale SKU) with pricing bands and renewal uplift. will include sample private-offer templates.
Jordan (partnerships): perfect. Lina can you draft the minimal clause language for the private-offer + HW credit fulfillment? we need a short boilerplate legal snippet to include in offer ops doc.
Lina (legal): will do. quick Q — do we expect credits to be payable to customer or to the reseller? (marketplace rules differ)
Deepak (hw-partner): credits to reseller is preferred for our ops, but we can accept customer-directed credit if reseller/legal requires it. prefer reseller route.
Sam (marketplace-sales): ok mark as "reseller-credit" by default. I’ll annotate exceptions in the spreadsheet.
offer-bot: draft-offer: offer-2026-04-07-001 (status: draft) -> contains placeholders for sku_ids, tier_breaks, hw_credit_code.
Jordan (partnerships): signal / analytics: we need one activation event name (e.g., `redwood.appliance.activated`) to tie to crediting. Deepak confirm event exists and who owns the webhook.
Deepak (hw-partner): event exists on our side. we can POST to a Redwood ingestion endpoint. sample for ops:
```
curl -X POST https://ingest.redwood.com/events \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"event":"redwood.appliance.activated","customer_id":"ACME-123","device_serial":"SN-999","activated_at":"2026-04-20T14:00:00Z"}'
```
Elise (field-ops): excellent. ops checklist item: ensure partner integration test is done by Apr 2. I’ll schedule a quick runbook review with Deepak.
Sam (marketplace-sales): uploading initial SKU spreadsheet now — https://drive.google.com/drive/fake-link/SKU-repack-v1 (will replace with final).
Lina (legal): also flagging data residency + audit clause — marketplace may require auditability of credit redemption. will draft short audit addendum.
Jordan (partnerships): risks: 1) marketplace private-offer latency on approval (some clouds take 48-72h) — plan for contingency SKUs. 2) HW credit reconciliation delays — need reconciliation window in the clause.
Deepak (hw-partner): agree on reconciliation window — propose 120 days after activation to reconcile credits.
Sam (marketplace-sales): noted. also to decide: renewal uplift incentive — do we tier an extra 5% off if renewals convert to 24mo within 60 days? thoughts?
Elise (field-ops): that helps capture renewals; prefer incentive targeted (not sitewide) so renewals team can run campaigns.
Lina (legal): conditional incentives fine but will require clear eligibility rules in the offer text.
Jordan (partnerships): final action list: Sam -> SKU spreadsheet + private-offer templates (owner). Lina -> legal clause + audit addendum. Deepak -> confirm webhook endpoint + credit amount (owner). Elise -> schedule ops test/runbook by Apr 2. Jordan -> partner sync Thu 10am PT to sign off.
Sam (marketplace-sales): got it. will ping once spreadsheet uploaded. :thumbsup:
Deepak (hw-partner): will confirm credit ladder by EOD tomorrow.
Lina (legal): drafting now, will share a short snippet here for review.
Elise (field-ops): booked Thu 10am PT on calendar and added partner test slot Apr 2.
Jordan (partnerships): thanks everyone — short PR for partner announcement once we have final SKUs and legal snippet.
Sam (marketplace-sales): ack.
Lina (legal): ack.
Deepak (hw-partner): ack.
Elise (field-ops): ack.
